**Component**
Which part of LANCommander this affects:
- [ ] Server
- [ ] Launcher
- [ ] SDK / scripting
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: [describe]

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, workarounds, or existing features you've tried.

**Screenshots / mockups**
If applicable, add screenshots or mockups to help explain your idea.

**Versions:**
 - LANCommander.Server version: [e.g. 2.2.1]
 - LANCommander.Launcher version: [e.g. 2.2.1]

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the feature request here. If this needs a new or expanded plugin API, use the Plugin API request template instead.
